articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks: Is this the season Touré finally fulfils his promise?
articles.description: Al Hassan Touré starred, Joey Garuccio saved Adelaide, and the pressure is already building at one of the A-League's biggest clubs -- all that and more in ESPN's Stocks Up, Stocks Down.

images.name: Valadon scores a rocket in 2-2 draw with Adelaide
images.caption: Melbourne Victory scored two in five minutes to take the lead over Adelaide before Joey Garuccio knocking home a late equaliser.

articles.headline: Western Sydney Wanderers decry policing at A-League games: 'Enough is enough'
articles.description: Western Sydney Wanderers chair Paul Lederer has hit out at what he has said is "totally unacceptable" policing of his club's supporters, labelling it excessive and declaring that "enough is enough."

images.name: Valadon scores his first A-League goal for Victory
images.caption: Jordi Valadon levels the scores for 10-men Melbourne, firing home an absolute ROCKET from outside the box.

articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks: The Nix nobody saw coming
articles.description: The Phoenix are the A-League's only perfect team, the Jets are searching for answers, and Victory's Valadon scores a stunner -- all that and more in ESPN's Stocks Up, Stocks Down.

images.name: Awer Mabil scores the match winner for Melbourne City
images.caption: For the first time in over 11 years, Awer Mabil has scored an A-League goal, sealing the victory over Sydney FC.

articles.headline: A-Leagues' financial woes: How solvent is Australia's top tier?
articles.description: Unbundling from Football Australia was supposed to herald a new dawn for soccer Down Under. Instead, an ESPN investigation asks: are the A-Leagues at risk of collapse?

images.name: Luis Garcia [1296x729]
images.caption: Fox Sports ended its 16-year association with the A-Leagues in 2021.

images.name: Newcastle Jets vs. Melbourne City [1296x729]
images.caption: The COVID-19 pandemic was a body blow that the A-Leagues are still trying to recover from.

images.name: Silver Lake [1296x729]
images.caption: Silver Lake "made a significant minority investment" in the Australian Professional Leagues in December 2021.

images.name: Valadon scores his first A-League goal for Victory
images.caption: Jordi Valadon levels the scores for 10-men Melbourne, firing home an absolute ROCKET from outside the box.

articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks: Has Talay fixed the Wanderers?
articles.description: Talay's Wanderers dazzled, Melbourne's heavyweights misfired and an unexpected contender is already shaking up the A-League table.

images.name: Miguel Di Pizio [1296x729]
images.caption: Miguel Di Pizio, 22, was in fine form as the Wanderers romped to a 5-2 win over Auckland on Saturday.

images.name: Franco Lino and Nathaniel Atkinson [1296x729]
images.caption: Has the A-Leagues' plan to open the season with a bunch of derbies yielded the results they wanted?

images.name: Youlley sparks Sydney's comeback with a beauty from range
images.caption: Rhys Youlley fires home from outside the box as Sydney FC fight back to claim a 2-1 win.

articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks Round 1: I've got chulls
articles.description: Each week, ESPN's experts will take you through the weekend's action across the A-League Men and the A-League Women to give you the lowdown on whose stocks are up, whose stocks are down, and what has the people talking coming out of the weekend.

images.name: Stocks [1296x729]
images.caption: Whose stocks are up and down after the opening round of the new A-League Mens' season?

images.name: Lachlan Bayliss of Auckland FC celebrates after scoring a goal  [1296x729]
images.caption: Lachlan Bayliss of Auckland FC celebrates after scoring a goal d

images.name: Aspropotamitis' late winner gives Macarthur victory over Perth
images.caption: Macarthur's Jonathan Aspropotamitis snatches victory from Perth Glory with a thumping header off Ryan Fraser's brilliant free kick.
